decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith Design Statement, Access Statement, Sustainability Statement, Outline Specification, Drawing Numbers 
A9303-1960-HLM-DRE-S001-04, DRE-S002-01, DSP-101-02, DRE-S003-01; A9303-1960-HLM-DR-L001-03, DR-L002-03, DR-L003-03, DR-L004-03, DR-L009-03, DR-L010-03, DR-L011-02; A9303-1960-HLM-DR-L101-03, DR-L110-03, DR-L111-03, DR-L112-03, DR-L113-03; A9303-1960-HLM-DR-E101-04, DR-S101-03; A9303-1960-HLM-DR-L201-03, DR-L210-04, DR-L211-04, DR-L212L-04, DR-L213-03, DR- E201-05, DR-S201-03, DR-L300-05, DR-L301-03, DR-L302-04, DR-L303-03 received 09/11/12
and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No work permitted by this consent shall commence until a detailed specification of the proposed mortar mix and pointing  have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved specification.
Condition : 4 - Angle grinders or other mechanical cutting tools shall not, unless otherwise agreed in writing, be used for cutting out of stonework, brickwork and / or chasing out for repointing.

Condition : 5 - Other than those shown on the submitted drawings  under this listed building consent, there shall be no external alterations to the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 6 - Full details of any acoustic insulation and fire precautions works to demonstrate their effect on the character and appearance of the listed building shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of the development hereby permitted and the development shall be carried out in complete accordance with the detail so approved.

Condition : 7 - All new window frames, glazing bars, weights and ironmongery and external doorframes shall be of timber construction, white painted with joinery profiles to match originals and thereafter so maintained.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, large scale details (at a scale of at least 1:20) of the following features shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and no work shall commence in advance of that approval. These details shall provide for a cross sectional detailed drawing at 1:20 scale (or different where acceptable) for each feature and/or, where relevant only provide, a written methodology and the development shall be constructed in accordance with the details so approved:

The secondary glazing units
The sash windows repairs
Any new window reveals (on the first and second floors)
The staircase balustrades and banisters which are covered and to be uncovered and refurbished.
 Any replacement banisters and balustrades
How the roofslates will be fixed to the existing timbers
Details of sarking, felt battens, counter battens, the splicing in of new battens and thermal insulation in the roof structure
The bin store, bootwash and bicycle shed

Condition : 9 - The permitted works shall not take place until drawings detailing the main elevational scaffold and protective roof scaffold, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Protection from the weather in accordance with the scheme shall be provided at all times during the progress of work.

Condition : 10 - No cables, wires, aerials, pipework (except a television aerial and rainwater downpipes as shown on the approved plans, or approved under condition), meter boxes or flues shall be fixed to any elevation.

Condition : 11 - This approval is limited to the works shown on the approved drawings and does not indicate approval for associated or enabling works that may be necessary to carry out the scheme. Any further works must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any works commencing.

Condition : 12 - The smoke detectors, fire alarm call points, fire alarms, emergency lighting fittings and control boxes shall be located, where possible, in unobtrusive positions in the corners of rooms and their electrical cabling systems shall not be surface mounted but concealed within the floors, ceilings and walls, except where otherwise approved, and the walls, floors and ceilings made good to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 13 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 14 - No excavation, demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 7.00am to 5:00pm on Monday to Friday and 7:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 15 - Before the commencement of development hereby granted, and in accordance with the applicants Design Statement details of the surveys and the scope of works for the walls, windows, brickwork, grilles, roof (and where necessary ceilings with regard to the retention of cornices), floors and rainwater goods shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and the details so approved shall be implemented in full before the development is first brought into use unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 16 - No works shall take place until details of the replacement materials and/or design (including roof tiles unless as otherwise approved under application 00092/A/L11- Cembrit Glendyne Blue/Grey submitted), of the chimney stone banding, bricks (including where necessary sample panels with mortar/pointing), decorative grilles,  decorative balustrade over the front door, rainwater goods, ironmongery, gutters and flashing, new windows, doors, replacement lights (and, if applicable, their new locations),  and any other materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the works hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 17 - All existing architectural features including staircases, balustrades, windows, doors, architraves, skirtings, dados, picture rails, panel work, fireplaces, tiling, corbelled arches, cornices, decorative ceilings and other decorative features not shown as being removed in the application, shall be retained except where otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 18 - Any original features which are uncovered during investigative work shall be catalogued and either reinstated or made good, or protected and boxed behind new partitions and ceilings. Details should be sent to the Local Planning Authority for their records and approval, in writing, of proposed action

Condition : 19 - Details of the mild wash solution which is to be used to clean the brickwork and the methodology of removing the climbing vegetation shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Provision of 57 senior and junior officer bedrooms within the existing Barracks Officers Mess Grade 2 listed building to include works to existing roof, internal layout alterations, maintaining and improving the external fabric without altering the Grade II frontage and demolition of small lean to stores and plant room to rear elevation.
